title: BUG: Fixed a crash when reading VASP output files
body:
Certain versions of VASP will write POTCAR hashes to the CONTCAR in place of element symbols, e.g. "Na_pv/6a2f546d" where ASE expects "Na". This caused ase.io.vasp.read_vasp_configuration to crash when it tried to treat the POTCAR hash as an element. This has been fixed with a few additional lines, and no existing code has been altered.

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Thank you @pprussell for the fix and @stly for your review!
The change looks reasonable also to me.
We just need to add a test. I would suggest `ase/test/fio/vasp/test_poscar.py` and
```python
def test_read_atom_types_with_hashes() -> None:
    """Test if `read_vasp` can read atom types with POTCAR hashes."""
    atoms = read_vasp(io.StringIO(BUF_WITH_HASHES))
    numbers_ref = [1]  # if one hydrogen atom
    np.testing.assert_allclose(atoms.numbers, numbers_ref)
```
with minimal realistic `BUF_WITH_HASHES`.

Apart from that, please also address a few my other minor suggestions.
